strategic_rationale: Direct like-for-like replacement for Shimron Hetmyer. World-class 360-degree boundary hitter against both high pace and spin at death. Elite boundary rider and versatile backup off-spinner.
High-impact domestic Indian finisher. Generates +41.1 runs above expectation per 100 death balls. Preserves an overseas slot and frees up auction purse for elite death bowling.
Ex-RR familiarity. Extreme raw power to clear SMS Stadium's long square boundaries (70m+). Bowls both off-spin and leg-spin to exploit matchup advantages.
Aggressive counter-attacker from ball one. Seamlessly partners with Dhruv Jurel at Nos. 5 and 6, providing dual Indian wicketkeeper-finisher flexibility.
Experienced left-handed middle-order stabilizer capable of accelerating to 200.0 SR at the death. Disrupts spin matchups in middle overs.
The gold standard in death execution. Low-release sling yorkers produce a sub-8.00 RPO economy under pressure across 373 death balls. Insulates Jofra Archer and Sandeep Sharma from workload burnout.
145+ km/h left-arm angle creates steep bounce and natural seam away from right-handers. Highest death dot-ball percentage (44.4%) among all evaluated fast bowlers.
High-speed skiddy pace bowler with exceptional international tournament pedigree. Yields sub-8.0 RPO at the death (+4.20 runs saved per 4 overs). Budget-friendly marquee alternative.
Ex-RR pacer with extensive home experience at SMS Jaipur. Towering release point exploits hard-length back-of-a-length bounce to protect long square boundaries.
Proven slower-cutter master with past RR tenure. Deceptive off-cutter grips exceptionally well on abrasive Jaipur surfaces, creating mis-timed aerial mishits.
